include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

// -------------------------------------------------------
// 4.1 后方通信车（中型综合通信车）
// 部署：联合基础网
// 通信：2路卫通（16Mbps）+ 1路微波（80Mbps）
// -------------------------------------------------------
platform_type REAR_COMM_PLATFORM WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature COMMAND_VEHICLE_SIG

  mover WSF_GROUND_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
  end_mover

  // 卫通链路A — 前向指令
  comm sat_link_a WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
        channels 4
        mode "default"
        transfer_rate 16 mbits/sec    //界面配置
        //bit_error_probability 0.00001
      end_mode
    end_medium

    transmitter 
      frequency 14.2 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      power 20 W    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter

    receiver
      frequency 11.8 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB    //界面配置
    end_receiver

    //internal_link network_access_delay
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  // 卫通链路B — 反向状态
  comm sat_link_b WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on

    network_name COM_MESH_NET

    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate 16 mbits/sec    //界面配置
        //bit_error_probability 0.00001
      end_mode
    end_medium
    
    transmitter
      frequency 14.2 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      power 20 W    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter

    receiver
      frequency 11.8 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB    //界面配置
    end_receiver

    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  // 微波链路
  comm microwave_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
     on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate 80 mbits/sec    //界面配置
      end_mode
    end_medium
    
    transmitter
      frequency 8.2 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 50 MHz    //界面配置
      power 20 W    //界面配置
      polarization horizontal
      antenna_pattern MICRO_REAR_PLATFORM_DIR_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter

    receiver
      frequency 8.2 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 50 MHz    //界面配置
      polarization horizontal
      antenna_pattern MICRO_REAR_PLATFORM_DIR_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB    //界面配置
    end_receiver

    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  // 光缆链路 — 连接集群指挥车节点
  comm fiber_link WSF_COMM_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name FIBER_NET
    transfer_rate 1000 mbits/sec
    channels 4
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR

    // ========== 前向业务主动发送：周期读 AuxData 最新路由 ==========
    execute at_interval_of 5 sec
      // 前向态势
      string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_next_platform_name");
      if (nxts != "") {
        Array<string> nexts = nxts.Split("|");
        Array<string> outs  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_out_port_name").Split("|");
        Array<string> ins   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
        Array<string> sizes = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_data_size").Split("|");
        foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts) {
          WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
          msg.SetType("kForwardSituation");
          msg.SetSizeInBits((int)sizes[i]);
          msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
          PLATFORM.Comm(outs[i]).SendMessage(msg, nxt, ins[i]);
        }
      }

      // 前向目标
      string nxts2 = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_next_platform_name");
      if (nxts2 != "") {
        Array<string> nexts2 = nxts2.Split("|");
        Array<string> outs2  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_out_port_name").Split("|");
        Array<string> ins2   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
        Array<string> sizes2 = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_data_size").Split("|");
        foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts2) {
          WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
          msg.SetType("kForwardTarget");
          msg.SetSizeInBits((int)sizes2[i]);
          msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
          PLATFORM.Comm(outs2[i]).SendMessage(msg, nxt, ins2[i]);
        }
      }
    end_execute

    //execute at_time 10 sec absolute
    //  WsfProcessor p = PLATFORM.Processor("link_calc");
    //  writeln("LINKCALC_CHECK: valid=", p.IsValid(), " on=", p.IsTurnedOn(), " interval=", p.UpdateInterval());
    //end_execute

    on_message
      
    end_on_message
  end_processor

  add processor link_calc WSF_LINK_CALC_PROCESSOR

    update_interval 5 sec

    emergency_threshold 1e-5
    warning_threshold   1e-6
    value_threshold_ber 1e-7
    jamming_range  30
    channel_encoding_scheme 0

    traffic_type            [{"mission_uav_02":{"forward":[{"traffice_type":"kForwardSituation","data_volume_bits":256,"trans_freq":5},{"traffice_type":"kForwardTarget","data_volume_bits":512,"trans_freq":10}],"return":[{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconVideo","data_volume_bits":8192,"trans_freq":3},{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconStatus","data_volume_bits":512,"trans_freq":10}]}},{"mission_uav_03":{"forward":[{"traffice_type":"kForwardSituation","data_volume_bits":256,"trans_freq":5},{"traffice_type":"kForwardTarget","data_volume_bits":128,"trans_freq":10}],"return":[{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconVideo","data_volume_bits":4096,"trans_freq":5},{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconStatus","data_volume_bits":256,"trans_freq":10}]}}]
    relay_uav_names         ["mission_uav_01"]
    hot_link_ret            {"link1":[{"platform":"mission_uav_02","inPort":"","outPort":"c_band_downlink"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"c_band_downlink","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":""}],"link2":[{"platform":"mission_uav_03","inPort":"","outPort":"c_band_downlink"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"c_band_downlink","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":""}]}
    hot_link_fw             {"link1":[{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":"c_band_uplink"},{"platform":"mission_uav_02","inPort":"c_band_uplink","outPort":""}],"link2":[{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":"c_band_uplink"},{"platform":"mission_uav_03","inPort":"c_band_uplink","outPort":""}]}
